Generate -> draft output
Evaluate -> does this satisfy the goal? what's wrong?
  satisfied     -> done, output the draft
  NOT satisfied -> feedback -> Generate again (revised) -> ...
caption: Anthropic's own name for this. Two roles, even if one model.
